title: Sensex +8.8%, Nifty +8.6%: Why India Rallied | FinTimes
description:
Why did the Sensex surge 8.8% and Nifty 50 rise 8.6% in the week ending 6 November 2026, even as global AI and technology shares came under pressure?

In this FinTimes financial news explainer, we break down the India stock market rally in simple English: falling crude oil prices, foreign investment inflows, bank stocks, global AI valuations, what the news means for India, and both the opportunities and risks. No stock tips. No guaranteed predictions.
